entities.title: Terse C# view
entities.summary: Builds a shortened view of one C# file that keeps what the code does and its source line numbers, for the view tool.
entities.purpose: Holds TerseView, which parses a C# file with Roslyn and applies syntactic rules (collapse usings, field-assigning constructors and log-and-rethrow catches; hide logging and #region lines; drop access modifiers; use var where the type is spelled out; shorten long local names), then renders and formats the view lines.
boundaries: It works on source text only: the view tool in src/Tools/ reads the file, resolves its path and logs the call.
It never writes files; the view is for reading, and zazzle read says to read with --source for the code and the sha every edit needs.

Its only dependency is the Roslyn package the project already uses (src/.dev/decisions.json, roslyn-and-sqlite-packages); the semantic model it asks for comes from a compilation of the one file, with no references.
